token.label: API Key
token.description:
Your Bannerbear API key. Both key types work:
- **V5 key** (starts with `bb_ak_v5_`): in Bannerbear open **Settings → API Keys** and create a key.
- **V2 project key** (older accounts): open your project, then **Settings → API Key**.

Master keys are not supported.

template_version.label: Template version
template_version.description: Render a specific template version. Leave empty for latest.

transparent.label: Transparent background
transparent.description: Render a PNG with a transparent background.

render_pdf.label: Render a PDF
render_pdf.description: Also render a PDF (uses extra credits).

metadata.label: Metadata
metadata.description: Any text to store with the image, e.g. a record ID.

wait_for_completion.label: Wait for Completion
wait_for_completion.description: Wait up to 2 minutes for the render; else return pending.

get_image.label: Get Image
get_image.description: Get an image and its status by ID.

image_uid.label: Image ID
image_uid.description: The image UID returned by Create Image.

list_images.label: List Images
list_images.description: List images, one page at a time.

list_templates.label: List Templates
list_templates.description: List image templates, optionally filtered by name or tag.

name.label: Name Contains
name.description: Only templates whose name contains this text.
